actors.name: Mayor of Riverton
actors.private_context: The mayor is aware of this morning's third water-main burst and the public concern it is generating. They have not yet decided whether to issue a public statement. They consider the political and operational implications of speaking out or staying silent.

shared_context: Riverton has experienced three water-main bursts this morning (2026-08-12). The third burst occurred earlier today. The mayor's office is the usual channel for official public statements. The public and local media are paying attention.

starting_events.description: The third water-main burst of the morning has occurred. The mayor is aware of it.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the mayor of Riverton issued a public statement about the water-main failures before 2026-08-14T07:00:00-06:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
